curated-gf-playwrite-de-va-baskervville: Looping, friendly handwriting with small round bodies on tall stems. Baskervville follows in a text serif, its thick downstrokes and hairline crossbars giving a long stretch of reading a dignified, finely cut texture that Playwrite DE VA never attempts.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-va-guides-gf-im-: Playwrite DE VA Guides writes like a relaxed hand, with lowercase well below its capitals. curated-gf-playwrite-de-va-guides-gf-pla: Playwrite DE VA Guides looks like casual pen strokes, short lowercase under tall capitals. curated-gf-playwrite-dk-loopet-gf-glory: Strokes bend at constant width, like neon tubing twisted into loopy letters. Playwrite DK Loopet is the relaxed, handwritten talker, while Glory, a sans-serif with snug word texture and terminals that stay open, handles the clean, steady reading.

curated-gf-playwrite-dk-uloopet-guides-g: El Messiri reads clean and modern, a sans-serif with moderate stroke contrast and a wide slot in each c.
